name: a complicated process resolves into one pipeline strand
looks: A card naming the process as complicated sits on a busy striped texture, then dissolves into a single blue arrow drawing across a plain field under a claim about one pipeline doing it all. Small round stage icons pop onto the arrow one at a time, each named for a step of production, left to right, until the whole line is strung with them.
build: The pipeline-icon-strand mechanic: the striped card is a textured DOM background that cuts away; the arrow is an SVG path stroked on with strokeDashoffset; stage markers pop in (scale 0 -> 1, back.out) along the path at even intervals, staggered left to right.
sound: A busy rattle under the complicated-process card settling into quiet, a whoosh as the arrow draws, a soft tick per icon landing.
prompt: Name a process as complicated on a busy, textured card, then cut to a calm field where a single arrow draws itself across the frame under a claim about one pipeline doing it all, and pop a run of small labelled stage markers onto that arrow one at a time, left to right, so a whole multi-step process reads as one continuous thread.
